metadata.title: Supported Contract Types for AI Review
metadata.description: Explore the commercial, employment, technology, data, and partner agreements supported by ContractReview AI.

showcases.title: AI contract review coverage
showcases.description: ContractReview AI is designed for common business contracts and structured legal review workflows.

items.title: Sales and supply agreements
items.description: Review supplier terms, purchase agreements, distribution terms, delivery obligations, and payment clauses.

items.title: Services and consulting agreements
items.description: Analyze statements of work, deliverables, acceptance rules, service levels, and liability boundaries.

items.title: Employment and contractor contracts
items.description: Check employment agreements, contractor terms, compensation provisions, confidentiality, and IP ownership.

items.title: SaaS and software agreements
items.description: Review SaaS terms, software licenses, implementation scopes, support duties, and renewal language.

items.title: NDAs and confidentiality terms
items.description: Assess confidentiality scope, exclusions, permitted disclosure, residual knowledge, and survival periods.

items.title: Data processing agreements
items.description: Review DPA clauses, security obligations, subprocessors, audit rights, breach notice, and data return terms.

items.title: Partner and reseller agreements
items.description: Analyze channel duties, revenue share, territory, exclusivity, customer ownership, and termination rights.

items.title: Platform and marketplace terms
items.description: Review platform rules, API usage, listing terms, moderation rights, revenue share, and account suspension clauses.
